# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest for OP-16 Anchors

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to compute edge_capture, OOS, and real-fills on the top-3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to evaluate any strategy candidate against OP-16 anchors. This analysis will provide the baseline engine behavior on J's source-of-truth trade days.

## Mechanism

Run the autoresearch grinder harness Stage-1 backtest on the current engine (or a baseline) to produce P&L for each of the six J days (3 winners, 3 losers). Compute edge_capture as sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers). Also compute OOS performance and real-fills validation on top-3 J days.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (as per OP-20).
2. **Sample bias:** We are analyzing the fixed set of 6 J days (3 winners, 3 losers) which is the source-of-truth for OP-16; risk of overfitting to these days is high if we tune to them.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we have not performed walk-forward held-out window).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we have not run real-fills simulation on top-3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loss on a loser day if the engine takes the trade; max drawdown scenario; blow-up if engine takes all losers and misses winners.
6. **Concentration:** If the strategy's P&L is concentrated on these 6 days, we will disclose after backtest.
